objective_pt: Contar uma história pessoal com começo, meio e fim, usando passado contínuo para o cenário ("I was walking home when..."), passado simples para os fatos e conectores ("First", "Then", "Suddenly", "In the end").

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer lembrando de uma situação engraçada ou estranha.
prompts: Has anything funny happened to you recently?
What were you doing at eight o'clock last night?
watchFor: Contar tudo no presente ("So I go to the store and I see..."); no nível B1, treine o passado.
Dizer "I was walk"; o passado contínuo é "was + -ing".

exercises.prompt: You won't believe what happened to me yesterday.
accepted: You won't believe what happened to me yesterday
You will not believe what happened to me yesterday

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga que você estava jantando.
exercises.listen: What were you doing at eight o'clock last night?
accepted: I was having dinner
I was eating dinner
I was having dinner at home
I was having dinner with my family
I think I was having dinner
I was making dinner
I was cooking dinner

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O passado contínuo é "was" + verbo com "-ing": "I was having dinner".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was having dinner.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Refeições vão sem artigo: "having dinner".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was having dinner.

exercises.instruction_pt: Qual frase descreve uma ação interrompida por outra?
options: I walked home when it started to rain.
I was walking home when it started to rain.
I was walk home when it started to rain.
exercises.explanation_pt: A ação longa (o cenário) vai no passado contínuo: "I was walking". A ação curta que interrompe vai no passado simples: "it started".

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender conectores e expressões para dar ritmo a uma história.
prompts: How do you start a story in English?
watchFor: Usar "In the final" para "no final"; é "In the end" ou "At the end".
Repetir "and then" o tempo todo; varie com "after that", "suddenly", "luckily".

exercises.example_en: Luckily, someone found my wallet and gave it back.

exercises.meaning_pt: no final, no fim das contas
exercises.example_en: In the end, we missed the flight, but we had a great time.
It turned out that the man was my neighbor's brother.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "No final, deu tudo certo."
accepted: In the end, everything worked out
In the end, it all worked out
In the end, everything was fine
In the end, everything turned out fine
In the end, everything turned out okay
In the end, everything went well
In the end, it all worked out fine

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Dar certo" não é "give right". Use "work out" ou "turn out fine".
commonErrors.correction_en: In the end, everything worked out.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No final" de uma história é "In the end". "The final" é a final de um campeonato.
commonErrors.correction_en: In the end, everything worked out.

teacher.goal_pt: Pronunciar a forma fraca de "was" e o final "-ed" em histórias.
prompts: Say "I was walking" quickly. Do you hear "wuz"?
watchFor: Acentuar "was" no meio da frase; ele é fraco: "wəz".
Pronunciar "walked" como "uólquedi"; é "wókt", uma sílaba só.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. O "was" é fraco e rápido.
exercises.prompt: I was waiting for the bus when I saw an old friend.
accepted: I was waiting for the bus when I saw an old friend

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. "Walked" e "stopped" terminam em som de "t"; "started" tem o "-ed" como sílaba.
exercises.prompt: We walked, we stopped, and then it started to rain.
accepted: We walked, we stopped, and then it started to rain

exercises.explanation_pt: Depois de som surdo (k, p, s, sh, ch, f), o "-ed" soa como "t": walked = "wókt".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender uma história curta e reagir com perguntas e comentários.
watchFor: Reagir só com "Ok"; ensine "Oh no!", "What did you do?", "That's hilarious!".
Perguntar "What you did?"; é "What did you do?".

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a história e escolha o que aconteceu.
exercises.listen: I was cooking dinner when the fire alarm went off. It turned out that I'd left a towel on the stove. Luckily, nobody was hurt.
options: Houve um incêndio grande e alguém se feriu.
O alarme tocou por causa de um pano no fogão, e ninguém se feriu.
O alarme tocou sem motivo enquanto ela dormia.
exercises.explanation_pt: "The fire alarm went off" = o alarme tocou; "I'd left a towel on the stove" = tinha deixado um pano no fogão; "nobody was hurt" = ninguém se feriu.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça o começo da história e pergunte o que a pessoa fez.
exercises.listen: So I got to the airport and realized I'd left my passport at home.
accepted: Oh no! What did you do
What did you do
No way! What did you do
Really? What did you do
Oh no! So what did you do
What happened then

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta no passado, use o auxiliar "did" antes do sujeito: "What did you do?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Oh no! What did you do?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "did", o verbo principal volta à forma base: "What did you do?".
commonErrors.correction_en: Oh no! What did you do?

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda que você estava andando de bicicleta quando caiu.
exercises.listen: How did you break your arm?
accepted: I was riding my bike when I fell
I was riding my bike and I fell
I was riding a bike when I fell
I was riding my bike when I fell off
I fell off my bike
I was cycling when I fell
I was riding my bicycle when I fell

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O passado de "fall" é "fell". Cuidado: "felt" é o passado de "feel" (sentir).
commonErrors.correction_en: I was riding my bike when I fell.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Andar de bicicleta" é "ride a bike".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was riding my bike when I fell.

teacher.goal_pt: Contar uma história completa de 1 a 2 minutos, com cenário, problema, reação e final.
prompts: Tell me about the most embarrassing moment of your life.
Have you ever got lost somewhere?
Tell me about a time something went wrong on a trip.
watchFor: Misturar presente e passado sem perceber.
Esquecer conectores; peça pelo menos três: "First", "Suddenly", "In the end".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu estava dormindo quando o telefone tocou."
accepted: I was sleeping when the phone rang
I was asleep when the phone rang
I was sleeping when my phone rang
I was asleep when my phone rang

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ring" é irregular: o passado é "rang".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A ação que estava acontecendo vai no passado contínuo: "I was sleeping".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Telefone "tocar" é "ring" (passado "rang"). "Touch" é tocar com a mão.
commonErrors.correction_en: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Acabou que ele era o novo chefe."
accepted: It turned out that he was the new boss
It turned out he was the new boss
Turns out he was the new boss
It turns out he was the new boss
As it turned out, he was the new boss

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Acabou que" (descobriu-se) é "It turned out that", e não "finished/ended that".
commonErrors.correction_en: It turned out that he was the new boss.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Chefe no trabalho é "boss". "Chief" é usado em cargos como "chief of police".
commonErrors.correction_en: It turned out that he was the new boss.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: While we were driving, the car broke down.

exercises.instruction_pt: Conte uma história real que aconteceu com você.
exercises.prompt_en: Tell me about a time when something unexpected happened to you.
guidelines_pt: Dê o cenário no passado contínuo: "It was a Saturday and I was...".
Conte os fatos no passado simples com conectores: "Suddenly...", "Then...", "After that...".
Termine com o final e como você se sentiu: "In the end... I felt...".

teacher.goal_pt: Fixar passado contínuo x passado simples e os verbos irregulares mais comuns em histórias.
prompts: What were you doing when you heard some big news?
Tell me a story in three sentences.

exercises.prompt: To cut a long story short, we never found the keys.
accepted: To cut a long story short, we never found the keys
To make a long story short, we never found the keys

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Enquanto eu esperava, começou a chover."
accepted: While I was waiting, it started to rain
While I was waiting, it started raining
While I was waiting, it began to rain
It started to rain while I was waiting
It started raining while I was waiting

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês a chuva precisa de sujeito: "it started to rain".
commonErrors.correction_en: While I was waiting, it started to rain.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Ação em andamento no passado: "While I was waiting".
commonErrors.correction_en: While I was waiting, it started to rain.

exercises.sentence: We ___ having lunch when the power went out.
accepted: were

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "we", o passado de "be" é "were".
commonErrors.correction_en: We were having lunch when the power went out.

practice.example_en: We were having dinner when, all of a sudden, the lights went out.
When I got home, I realized I'd lost my wallet.

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. Passado contínuo para o cenário, passado simples para a interrupção.
practice.prompt: I was walking home when it started to snow.
accepted: I was walking home when it started to snow
I was walking home when it started snowing

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase com suspense.
practice.prompt: All of a sudden, someone knocked on the door.
accepted: All of a sudden, someone knocked on the door
All of a sudden somebody knocked on the door

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "I'd left" é o passado do passado.
practice.prompt: When I got to the station, the train had already left.
accepted: When I got to the station, the train had already left
When I got to the station the train had already gone

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a frase.
practice.prompt: Luckily, a stranger helped me find the way.
accepted: Luckily, a stranger helped me find the way
Luckily a stranger helped me to find the way

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "Turned out" liga: "turnd-out".
practice.prompt: It turned out that the shop was closed for the holiday.
accepted: It turned out that the shop was closed for the holiday
It turned out the shop was closed for the holiday

practice.instruction_pt: Repita a reação a uma história.
practice.prompt: No way! What did you do then?
accepted: No way! What did you do then
No way! So what did you do

practice.instruction_pt: Repita. "While" + passado contínuo.
practice.prompt: While we were driving to the beach, the car broke down.
accepted: While we were driving to the beach, the car broke down
While we were driving to the beach, our car broke down

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu estava tomando banho quando a luz acabou."
accepted: I was taking a shower when the power went out
I was in the shower when the power went out
I was taking a shower when the lights went out
I was having a shower when the power went off
I was showering when the power went out
I was taking a shower when the electricity went out

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "A luz acabou" é "the power went out" ou "the lights went out".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was taking a shower when the power went out.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para a ação que estava em andamento, use o passado contínuo: "I was taking a shower".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was taking a shower when the power went out.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Quando eu cheguei, a festa já tinha acabado."
accepted: When I arrived, the party had already finished
When I got there, the party had already ended
When I arrived, the party was already over
When I got there, the party had already finished
When I arrived, the party had already ended
By the time I got there, the party was over

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para algo que aconteceu antes de outra ação no passado, use "had" + particípio: "had already finished".
commonErrors.correction_en: When I arrived, the party had already finished.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "there", diga "got there" ou "arrived" sozinho.
commonErrors.correction_en: When I got there, the party had already finished.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu percebi que tinha esquecido as chaves."
accepted: I realized I had forgotten my keys
I realized I'd forgotten my keys
I realized that I had forgotten my keys
I realised I'd forgotten my keys
I realized I'd forgotten the keys
I realized I had left my keys behind

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Perceber" (se dar conta) é "realize".
commonErrors.correction_en: I realized I'd forgotten my keys.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Use "had forgotten" (ou "I'd forgotten").
commonErrors.correction_en: I realized I'd forgotten my keys.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Por sorte, ninguém se machucou."
accepted: Luckily, nobody got hurt
Luckily, no one was hurt
Luckily, nobody was hurt
Fortunately, no one got hurt
Luckily, no one got hurt
Thankfully, nobody was hurt

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Por sorte" é "luckily" ou "fortunately".
commonErrors.correction_en: Luckily, nobody got hurt.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Machucar-se" num acidente é "get hurt". E "nobody" já é negativo.
commonErrors.correction_en: Luckily, nobody got hurt.

practice.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Resumindo, a gente perdeu o voo."
accepted: Long story short, we missed the flight
To cut a long story short, we missed the flight
In short, we missed the flight
Basically, we missed our flight
Long story short, we missed our flight

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Perder" o voo, o ônibus etc. é "miss". "Lose" é perder um objeto.
commonErrors.correction_en: Long story short, we missed the flight.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para "resumindo" numa história, diga "long story short" ou "in short".
commonErrors.correction_en: Long story short, we missed the flight.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga o que você estava fazendo: estava estudando.
practice.listen: What were you doing when I called you last night?
accepted: I was studying
I was studying for a test
Sorry, I was studying
I was studying, so I didn't hear the phone
I was studying in my room

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A pergunta é sobre uma ação em andamento: "I was studying".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was studying.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Passado contínuo: "was" + verbo com "-ing": "I was studying".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was studying.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e reaja com surpresa, perguntando o que aconteceu depois.
practice.listen: So I opened the door, and there was a huge dog in my kitchen!
accepted: No way! What happened next
Seriously? What happened then
Oh my God! What did you do
Really? What happened next
No way! What did you do

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Quando "what" é o sujeito, não use "did": "What happened next?"
commonErrors.correction_en: No way! What happened next?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta no passado: "What did you do?"
commonErrors.correction_en: No way! What did you do?

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga como terminou: no final, acharam o celular.
practice.listen: So did you ever find your phone?
accepted: Yes, in the end we found it
In the end, we found it
Yes, we found it in the end
Yes, luckily we found it in the end
Yeah, in the end it turned up

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No final" (de uma história) é "in the end". "At the end of" é para um momento: "at the end of the day".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, in the end we found it.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O passado de "find" é "found".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, in the end we found it.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e diga quando aconteceu: há uns dois anos.
accepted: About two years ago
It happened about two years ago
A couple of years ago
It was about two years ago
Around two years ago

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Há dois anos" é "two years ago".
commonErrors.correction_en: About two years ago.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Faz dois anos" é "two years ago".
commonErrors.correction_en: About two years ago.

practice.instruction_pt: Conte para um amigo o que aconteceu com você na viagem.
practice.scene_pt: Você voltou de viagem e um amigo quer saber como foi.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Hey, you're back! How was the trip?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que foi ótima, mas que aconteceu uma coisa engraçada.
accepted: It was great, but something funny happened
It was great, but something funny happened to me
Great! But something really funny happened
It was amazing, but something funny happened
It was great. Something funny happened, though

commonErrors.match: ^(it was great but )?happened something\b|\bhappened a funny thing\b
commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês o sujeito vem antes do verbo: "something funny happened".
commonErrors.correction_en: It was great, but something funny happened.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para algo que faz rir, use "funny". "Fun" é divertido.
commonErrors.correction_en: It was great, but something funny happened.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que você estava esperando o ônibus quando um macaco pegou o seu sanduíche.
accepted: I was waiting for the bus when a monkey took my sandwich
I was waiting for the bus when a monkey grabbed my sandwich
I was waiting for the bus and a monkey stole my sandwich
While I was waiting for the bus, a monkey took my sandwich
I was waiting at the bus stop when a monkey took my sandwich

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para a ação em andamento, use o passado contínuo: "I was waiting".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was waiting for the bus when a monkey took my sandwich.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Esperar" alguém ou algo é "wait for".
commonErrors.correction_en: I was waiting for the bus when a monkey took my sandwich.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: No way! What did you do?

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que tentou pegar de volta, mas ele fugiu para uma árvore.
accepted: I tried to get it back, but it ran up a tree
I tried to take it back, but it ran into a tree
I tried to get it back, but it ran away up a tree
I tried to get it back, but it escaped up a tree
I tried to get it back, but it climbed a tree

commonErrors.explanation_pt: No dia a dia, "fugiu" é "ran away" ou "ran up a tree".
commonErrors.correction_en: I tried to get it back, but it ran up a tree.

commonErrors.match: \btried get\b|\btry to get it back but\b
commonErrors.explanation_pt: Use o passado com "to": "I tried to get it back".
commonErrors.correction_en: I tried to get it back, but it ran up a tree.

turns.speaker: partner
turns.text: Ha! So you lost your lunch.

turns.speaker: you
turns.cue_pt: Diga que sim, mas que no final um turista dividiu a comida com você.
accepted: Yes, but in the end a tourist shared his food with me
Yeah, but in the end a tourist shared her food with me
Yes, but in the end a tourist shared their food with me
I did, but in the end a tourist shared his lunch with me
Yes, but luckily a tourist shared some food with me in the end

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No final" de uma história é "in the end".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, but in the end a tourist shared his food with me.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Dividir" comida com alguém é "share".
commonErrors.correction_en: Yes, but in the end a tourist shared his food with me.

practice.instruction_pt: Conte uma história de um dia em que tudo deu errado.
practice.prompt_en: Tell me about a day when everything went wrong.
guidelines_pt: Comece o cenário com o passado contínuo: "I was...".
Termine dizendo como você se sentiu.

practice.instruction_pt: Qual frase está correta?
options: I was watching TV when the doorbell rang.
I watched TV when the doorbell was ringing.
I was watching TV when the doorbell was ring.
practice.explanation_pt: A ação longa (cenário) vai no passado contínuo; a interrupção, no passado simples.

practice.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha o que aconteceu.
practice.listen: I was halfway to work when I realized I'd left the oven on, so I had to go all the way back home.
options: A pessoa esqueceu o forno ligado e voltou para casa.
A pessoa chegou atrasada porque o carro quebrou.
A pessoa deixou a chave no trabalho.
practice.explanation_pt: "I'd left the oven on" é "eu tinha deixado o forno ligado", e "go all the way back home" é voltar até em casa.

practice.instruction_pt: Complete com o passado de "break": "The car ___ down in the middle of the road."
practice.sentence: The car ___ down in the middle of the road.
accepted: broke

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O passado simples de "break" é "broke".
commonErrors.correction_en: The car broke down in the middle of the road.

practice.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: What happened after that?
